action.message:
I was unable to complete a verified fix. My edits to the allowed files (django/db/models/sql/compiler.py and django/db/models/sql/subqueries.py) were rejected by the editor tool with PermissionError on its history temp file, so no source change was actually written to disk. A subsequent scoped_tests run reported an IndentationError, indicating the workspace source is in a broken/inconsistent state, and public verification did NOT pass.

Root cause analysis (for the next attempt): In SQLUpdateCompiler.pre_sql_setup, related_ids are collected as the concrete child model's PK values. For multi-table inheritance with multiple parents, the child's PK equals only the FIRST parent's PK (the parent link). get_related_updates then filters each ancestor UpdateQuery with pk__in=related_ids, so updates to a second/grand parent target the wrong rows (or none), matching the failing tests test_mti_update_parent_through_child and test_mti_update_grand_parent_through_child.

Intended fix (not landed): select the parent-link column for each related model in pre_sql_setup (e.g. via self.query.get_meta().parents[model].attname) and store per-model id lists, then have get_related_updates filter each ancestor query using the ids for that specific model rather than the shared child PK list.

Status: incomplete and unverified. No allowed file was successfully modified; public regression selection did not pass.
